item.title: Victory Productions Launching Top Tier Diverse and Inclusive Performances in 2023
item.description: Victory Productions Launching Top Tier Diverse and Inclusive Performances in 2023 Winter Garden, FL – December 20, 2022 – Victory Productions, a full-serviceentertainment company that specializes in concert promotions, production of live theatreand special events announces today that it will be bringing major productions to theCentral Florida area in 2023 hosted at the Garden Theatre....
